name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 25, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Chaplain Steve Grubbs, The Elizabeth Hospice
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of Certificates of Appreciation to outgoing Beautification and Improvement Commissioners. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the check register.
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
Recommended Action:
Waive reading of ordinances on the agenda.
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
Recommended Action:
Approve the following Minutes:
September 11, 2007, Regular Meeting (CC/BSD/CDC)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinances (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt the following Ordinances:
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-18, entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Vista, California, Repealing Chapter 2.52 Beautification and Improvement Commission and Disestablishing the Beautification and Improvement Commission"; and
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2007-19, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed Limit of 35 Miles per Hour on S. Emerald Drive/Sunset Drive from W. Vista Way to the City Limit."
C5.
Appointment to the Parks and Recreation Commission (CC)
Recommended Action:
Confirm the Mayor's appointment of Amanda Young Rigby to the Parks and Recreation Commission to fill an unscheduled vacancy for a term ending June 30, 2009.
C6.
Amendment to the Consultant Agreement with Cornerstone Engineering (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the Third Amendment to the agreement with Cornerstone Engineering in the amount of $7,250 for the Grapevine Road Street Improvement Project Phase II, and authorizing the Mayor to sign the third amendment; and
2.
Authorize the City Manager to execute a future Fourth Amendment, in an amount not to exceed $25,000, for the Grapevine Road Street Improvement Project Phase II.
C7.
Buena Vista Creek Trail Extension Grant Applications (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a grant application to the Recreational Trails Program, and authorizing the City Manager to sign future grant-related documents on behalf of the City; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a grant application to the Habitat Conservation Fund Grant Program, and authorizing the City Manager to sign future grant-related documents on behalf of the City.
C8.
FM Global Fire Prevention Grant Application (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the submission of a grant application under the FM Global Fire Prevention Grant program and authorizing the City Manager to sign the application.
C9.
Regional Winter Shelter System and Emergency Shelter Declaration (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving participation in the Regional Winter Shelter System; authorizing the expenditure of up to $5,000 for the regional program; declaring the existence of a housing shelter crisis which allows area churches to operate individual shelters; and authorizing the City Manager to approve operating requirements.
C10.
Sewer Cleaning Truck Purchase (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving an agreement with Dion International Trucks for the purchase of a sewer cleaning and vacuum truck in the amount of $279,752, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.
C11.
Purchase of Dump Truck (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving an agreement with San Diego Freightliner for the purchase of a dump truck in the amount of $122,225.93, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement.
C12.
Gang Resistance Education and Training Program Grant (CC)
Recommended Action:
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , accepting the Gang Resistance Education and Training grant; authorizing the City Manager to sign related documents; and amending the Operating Budget for the Fiscal Year 2007-2008 for the grant program revenues received.
C13.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending July 31, 2007 (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive the report.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
City Council Goals 2007-2009 Update (CC)
Recommended Action:
Receive a status update on the 2007-2009 City Council goals.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
2006-2007 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) and 2008-2009 Objectives (CC)
Recommended Action:
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony;
2.
Accept and approve the 2006-2007 CAPER; and
3.
Discuss and provide direction regarding the 2008-2009 goals and objectives.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies
ADJOURNMENT
